blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Part and prototype-based explanations for Vision Transformers (ViTs) present a decision as evidence from individual image regions. However, self-attention mixes information across patches, so part-level features absorb context from the whole image and consequently fail to faithfully reflect the decision. We show that existing interpretable ViT classifiers depend heavily on this leakage: when each explained region is encoded in isolation, their accuracy collapses, and retraining them under isolation recovers only part of the lost accuracy. We propose a classifier that represents each image as a graph of isolated parts. Each part is encoded only from its own patches by a ViT whose last blocks are fine-tuned under isolation, preventing evidence leakage from elsewhere in the image. Parts are discovered without annotation and refined hierarchically through their sub-parts, making them more consistent and stable across images than those of competing methods. Each edge is computed from part pairs, and recovers evidence that attention previously shared across the object without affecting the parts. Matching the image graph to a learned prototype graph per class makes the prediction a direct combination of node and edge similarities, each computed only from the patches it is credited to, so every explanation is faithful by construction. Across 11 fine-grained and general-object benchmarks, our method exceeds the accuracy of existing explainable methods that rely on leakage, while providing explanations that reflect what the model actually uses.
blocks.zh: 基于部分和原型的"视觉变形器"(ViTs)解释提出了决定,作为单个图像区域的证据. 然而,自觉将信息混合到整个补丁中,因此分级特性吸收了整个图像的上下文,因此无法忠实地反映决定. 我们显示,现有的可解释的ViT分类器在很大程度上依赖于这种渗漏:当每个被解释的区域被编码为孤立区域时,它们的准确性会崩溃,在隔离下再培训它们只会恢复失去的准确性的一部分. 我们提出一个代表每个图像的分类器,作为孤立部分的图. 每个部分只被一个VIT从自己的补丁中编码出,其最后的块被隔离后微调出,防止了从图像中其他地方渗出的证据. 部件在不作注释的情况下被发现,并通过子部分进行分级精炼,使其在相竞方法的图像之间更加一致和稳定. 每个边由部分对来计算,并取回以前在物体上共享的注意而不影响部分的证据. 将图像图与每个类的学习到的原型图相匹配,使得预测直接结合了节点和边缘的相似性,每个被算入的补丁都只能计算出来,所以每个解释都是通过构造而忠实的. 在11个精细和一般目标基准中,我们的方法超过了依赖渗漏的现有可解释方法的准确性,同时提供了反映模型实际使用内容的解释.

blocks.en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) [ 20 ] now underpin much of visual recognition, yet our understanding of how they reach a decision has not kept pace with their accuracy [ 65 , 38 , 55 ] . Where decisions must be inspected or contested, as in health [ 42 , 61 ] or autonomous driving [ 45 , 19 ] , an explanation is only useful if it reflects what the model actually used. Post-hoc attributions such as attention rollout and gradient saliency [ 1 , 62 , 15 ] highlight where a model is sensitive, but can be insensitive to the model itself [ 2 ] , can be manipulated [ 64 ] , and can mislead users into trusting incorrect predictions [ 63 , 67 ] . Part- and prototype-based classifiers, instead, build the explanation into the decision itself, classifying an image because a part of it ‘looks like’ a prototypical part [ 16 ] and reporting the evidence of each part alongside the prediction [ 50 , 44 , 77 , 6 , 80 ] .
blocks.zh: 视觉变形器(ViTs)[20]现在是许多视觉识别的基础,然而我们对它们如何达成决定的理解并没有跟上其准确性[65,38,55]. 在必须检查或质疑决定的情况下,例如在卫生方面[42、61]或自主驾驶[45、19],解释只有在反映模型实际使用的内容时才有用。 热度后属性如注意力推出和梯度显著度[1,62,15]突出一个模型敏感但可能对模型本身不敏感之处[2],可被操纵[64],并可误导用户相信不正确的预测[63,67]. 而基于部分和原型的分类者则将解释纳入决定本身,将一个图像分类,因为其中一部分 " 看起来像 " 原型部分[16],并报告每一部分的证据与预测[50、44、77、6、80]。

blocks.en: Self-attention mixes information across all patches so, after a few blocks, a token located on a part also carries evidence from the rest of the image [ 1 , 5 ] , and evidence credited to a part may come from elsewhere, in which case the explanation shows where the model points rather than what it used [ 75 , 31 ] . We measure for the first time how much existing interpretable ViT classifiers depend on such leakage , by encoding their explained regions in isolation, so that each region sees only its own patches. We find that their accuracy collapses, dropping on CUB-200 [ 73 ] by 33 points for PDiscoFormer [ 6 ] and Zhu et al . [ 80 ] , by 40–48 points for ProtoPNet and ProtoPFormer [ 16 , 77 ] , and by 82 points for ProtoViT [ 44 ] . Retraining them under isolation recovers only part of this and, measured from pixels, 8–52% of the evidence a typical method assigns to a part changes when the other parts are removed. These classifiers depend on evidence their explanations do not show.
blocks.zh: 自觉将所有补丁的信息混为一谈,因此,在几个块之后,位于某一部分的标志也包含图像的其余部分[1,5]的证据,而贷记到某一部分的证据可能来自其他地方,在这种情况下,解释表明模型点的位置,而不是它使用的[75,31]。 我们第一次衡量现有可解释的ViT分类器在多大程度上依赖于这种渗漏,方法是将它们被解释的区域单独编码,以便每个区域只看到自己的补丁。 我们发现它们的精度崩溃,PDiscoFormer[6]和Zhu等人的精度下降33分,ProtoPNet和ProtoPFormer[16,77]的精度下降40–48分,ProtoViT[44]的精度下降82分. 在隔离下再训练它们只回收其中的一部分,从像素中测得,8-52%的证据是典型方法,当其他部分被移除时,它会改变一部分。 这些分类人员取决于其解释没有显示的证据。

blocks.en: We propose IsoPartFormer, a classifier that represents each image as a graph of isolated parts ( Fig. 1 ) and is built around a single constraint, which we call region faithfulness , that every term of the decision is computed only from the pixels to which it is credited. Each part is encoded only from its own patches, with positions expressed relative to the part, by a ViT whose early blocks are frozen and whose last blocks are fine-tuned under isolation. Since an isolated part can no longer borrow context, it must be informative on its own, so we discover parts without annotation by learning coarse object parts jointly with their finer sub-parts, which aligns the sub-parts markedly better with object anatomy. Rather than forbidding interaction between parts, we make it explicit. Two parts can exchange information only within an edge computed from that pair alone, whose term is credited to the pair and leaves the term of each part unchanged. Matching the image graph to a learned prototype graph per class then makes the prediction an exact sum of node and edge terms. Models that are faithful by construction have so far decomposed the decision over pixels [ 10 ] , patches [ 33 ] , or feature groups selected per image [ 78 ] , none of which correspond to the same region across images, whereas our unit is a semantic part shared across images, so that the part-level explanations through which part- and prototype-based models are read become faithful themselves. Our key contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们提议IsoPartFormer, 一个代表每个图像作为孤立部分的图(图1)的分类器, 每个部分只用自己的补丁编码,相对于该部分表示位置,由一个维T编码,其早期的块被冻结,最后的块在隔离下微调. 由于一个孤立的部分不再能借用上下文,它必须自己提供信息,所以我们通过与较细的子部分一起学习粗细的物体部分来发现部分而无需注释,这些子部分与对象解剖学的配合明显更好. 我们不是禁止各部分之间的互动,而是明确指出这一点。 两个部分只能在从两个部分计算出来的边缘内交换信息,这两个部分的期限计入两个部分,每一部分的期限保持不变。 将图像图与每个类的学习到的原型图相匹配,然后使预测成为节点和边缘术语的精确总和. 通过构建而忠实的模型到目前为止已经解析了对像素的决定 [10],补丁 [33],或者每个图像所选择的特征组 [78],这些特征组没有一个对应图像之间的同一区域,而我们的单位是图像之间共享的语义部分,这样部分层次的解释,通过这些解释来读取基于部分和原型的模型就会变得忠实自己. 我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: 1. We introduce an isolation audit, applicable to any classifier that explains its decision through image regions, and use it to show that state-of-the-art part- and prototype-based ViT classifiers depend heavily on evidence leaked through self-attention, losing most of their accuracy when their explained regions are encoded in isolation. 2. We propose IsoPartFormer, a classifier that is region-faithful by construction, in which each part is encoded as a separate token stream with part-relative positions and all interactions between parts are confined to pair edges that are themselves explained terms. 3. We introduce hierarchical part discovery that learns coarse object parts jointly with nested finer sub-parts without part annotation, yielding more consistent and stable parts across images than competing methods. 4. We show across 11 benchmarks that this guarantee does not require an accuracy sacrifice, since our model exceeds the mean accuracy of leaky interpretable classifiers and outperforms all of them under the same isolation on 10 of the benchmarks, while its explanations pass the model-randomisation test [ 2 ] , show no cross-part conflation, and predict the effect of removing a part far better than competing methods (rank correlation 0.94 vs. at most 0.34).
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 我们实行隔离审计,适用于任何通过图像区域解释其决定的分类人员,并利用该审计显示,最新水平的基于部分和原型的ViT分类人员严重依赖自觉泄露的证据,当其解释区域被单独编码时,其准确性将大半丧失。 2. 我们提议采用IsoPartFormer,这个分类器通过构建对区域有诚意,其中每个部分被编码为具有部分相对位置的单独的符号流,各个部分之间的所有相互作用都局限于本身被解释的对边。 3. 我们引入了分层部分的发现,这些发现与巢状较细的子部分共同学习粗细的物体部分,没有部分注释,在图像之间产生比相互竞争的方法更加一致和稳定的部分。 4. 我们从11项基准中显示,这一保障不需要精确牺牲,因为我们的模型超过了可解释分类器的平均精确度,并在10项基准的相同隔离下超越了所有基准,而其解释则通过模型随机化测试[2],没有显示交叉部分的混杂,并预测去除一部分的效果远胜于相互竞争的方法(在0.94对0.34中排名)。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Post-hoc saliency methods estimate which pixels or regions the output of a trained model is most sensitive to, using gradients, perturbations, class activation maps, or local surrogate models [ 62 , 66 , 54 , 57 , 43 ] . For Vision Transformers (ViTs) [ 20 , 68 ] , a further family of methods derives explanations from the attention weights by tracing how information flows between tokens across layers [ 1 , 15 ] . Such explanations can be insensitive to the model’s weights [ 2 ] , altered without changing the prediction [ 24 , 64 ] , or unfaithful to the underlying computation [ 75 , 67 ] . As such, there is increasing motivation to create models that are interpretable by design , in which the explanation is part of the decision process rather than an approximation computed afterwards.
blocks.zh: 热度后显性方法估计哪个像素或区域对训练有素的模型最敏感,使用梯度,扰动,类激活图,或局部代位模型[62,66,54,57,43]. 对于Vivision Transformers(ViTs)[20,68],还有一组方法从关注权重中得出解释,通过追踪信条之间如何跨层传递信息[1,15]. 这种解释可能对模型的权重不敏感[2],修改时不改变预测[24,64],或对基础计算不忠[75,67]. 因此,创造可按设计解释的模型的积极性越来越大,其中解释是决策过程的一部分,而不是事后计算的近似值。

blocks.en: Concept-based methods showed that deep networks can encode human-recognisable concepts [ 8 , 36 ] , with concept bottleneck models making this explicit by routing predictions through a layer of named concepts [ 40 ] , with recent work tying each concept to the attention map of a single object part [ 56 ] . Prototype-based classifiers apply the same principle to object parts [ 16 ] , classifying an image by the similarity of its regions to prototypical parts learned for each class. Subsequent work improved the prototypes themselves, organising them hierarchically [ 50 ] and making them sparser and more part-like [ 49 ] . With the adoption of ViTs, this approach was carried over to transformer backbones, where prototypes have been restricted to local neighbourhoods of tokens [ 77 , 44 ] , tied to a fixed set of discovered parts [ 6 ] , and built non-parametrically on foundation-model features [ 80 ] , while other interpretable ViTs explain a decision through the attention of class-specific queries or prompts [ 17 ] . Evaluations of these models have examined whether prototypes remain consistent across images and stable under perturbation [ 31 ] and whether users can make effective use of them [ 37 ] . They have also shown that the visualised region of a prototype need not reflect what the model uses [ 30 , 76 ] and that its activation can change when only pixels outside that region are modified [ 59 ] , while synthetic objects with removable parts allow part importances to be checked against ground truth [ 29 ] . Common to all of these models is that the evidence for a part is read from the tokens at the part’s location, which implicitly assumes that this evidence originates from the part itself. Since self-attention mixes information across the image, this assumption does not necessarily hold in a ViT, which we test directly in Sec. 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 基于概念的方法表明,深层网络可以编码人类可识别的概念[8,36],概念瓶颈模型通过一层命名概念的路由预测来明确这一点[40],最近的工作将每个概念与单个对象部分的注意图[56]. 基于原型的分类器对对象[16]部分适用同样的原则,按其区域与每个类所学的原型部分的相似性对一个图像进行分类. 随后的工作改进了原型本身,将其分级排列为[50],使其更加稀疏和部分类似[49]. 随着ViTs的采用,这一方法被结转到变压器骨干上,原型被限制在地區的代币[77,44],捆绑在一组固定的发现部件[6]上,并在基础模型特征上建造了非参数化[80],而其他可解释性. ViTs通过注意特定类别查询或提示来解释一项决定 [17]. 对这些模型的评价审查了原型在图像之间是否保持一致,在扰动下是否保持稳定[31],以及用户是否能够有效利用[37]。 他们还表明,原型的可视化区域不需要反映模型使用什么[30,76],当只有该区域以外的像素被修改[59]时,其激活可以改变,而具有可移动部件的合成物体则允许对照地面真理检查部分重要性[29]. 所有这些模型的共同之处在于,某一部分的证据是从该部分所在地的标志书中读取的,该标志书含蓄地假定该部分的证据本身就来自该部分。 由于自觉将信息混合到整个图像中,这个假设不一定在ViT中存在,我们直接在Sec. 3.1中测试.

blocks.en: Self-supervised ViTs provide a strong basis for discovering parts without annotation, since the patch features of DINO and DINOv2 [ 13 , 52 ] separate object parts and match them across images, a property that has been exploited for training-free co-segmentation and semantic correspondence [ 4 ] , unsupervised segmentation [ 26 ] , object discovery by partitioning a graph of patch tokens [ 74 ] , and the discovery of concepts that recur across a dataset [ 25 ] . Dedicated part-discovery methods even learn a fixed set of parts intended to correspond to the same region in every image of a category [ 32 , 69 , 6 ] . We build on the same features, but a part encoded in isolation has access only to its own pixels, and we therefore learn coarse object parts jointly with the finer sub-parts that compose them.
blocks.zh: 自我监督 ViTs为无注释地发现部件提供了坚实的基础,因为DINO和DINov2[13,52]的补丁特性将对象部件分开,并在图像之间相匹配,这一财产已被开发用于无训练共分和语义对应[4],无监督的分解[26],通过分割补丁符的图示来发现物体[74],并发现通过数据集重现的概念[25]. 专门化的部分发现方法甚至可以学习一组固定的部件,以便在一个类别的每个图像[32、69、6]中对应同一区域。 我们基于同样的特性,但是一个被隔离编码的部分只能访问它自己的像素,因此我们与组成它的更细小的子部分一起学习粗细的物体部分.

blocks.en: Relations between parts have also been studied extensively in pattern recognition, from deformable part models [ 22 ] and capsule networks [ 58 ] to relation networks [ 60 ] , scene graphs [ 34 ] , and graph neural networks [ 39 , 72 ] . In fine-grained classification, they have been modelled by relational transformers over discovered parts [ 79 ] , graphs of part relationships [ 14 ] , prototypes of part arrangements [ 7 ] and part matching with attention restricted to each part [ 9 ] . Since message passing would reintroduce the mixing that isolation removes, our graph instead confines every interaction between parts to an edge computed from a single pair, so that what two parts provide together is credited to that pair and the term of every individual part is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 各个部分之间的关系也从可变形部分模型[22]和胶囊网络[58]到关系网络[60],场景图[34],以及图表神经网络[39,72],在模式识别上进行了广泛的研究. 在精细的分类中,它们用关系变压器模拟了发现的部分[79],部分关系的图表[14],部分安排的原型[7]和部分的配对,只注意每个部分[9]. 由于信息传递将重新引入隔离消除的混合,我们的图表将每个部分之间的相互作用限制在从一对中计算出来的边缘上,这样两个部分共同提供的东西就记入该对,每个部分的术语不变。

blocks.en: Representations that carry information that their explanations do not reveal have been observed in several settings. Concept bottleneck models have been shown to leak label information through their concept representations [ 48 , 46 , 27 ] . Attention in transformers distributes information widely enough that a single token can come to reflect much of the input [ 1 ] , and ViT features attributed to one part of an object have been found to absorb information from its other parts, with consequences for attribute prediction [ 5 ] . Such evidence motivates processing parts in separate streams, but how much the accuracy of existing part- and prototype-based ViT classifiers depends on this leakage has not yet been measured.
blocks.zh: 在若干场合观察到载有其解释未显示的信息的说明。 概念瓶颈模型被证明通过其概念表述泄露了标签信息[48,46,27]. 变压器中的注意能将信息广为传播,以至于一个单一的符号可以来反映大部分输入[1],而归属于一个物体的一部分的ViT特性被发现会吸收来自其其他部分的信息,对属性预测产生后果[5]. 这种证据激励了不同流中的加工部分,但现有基于部分和原型的ViT分类器的准确性在多大程度上取决于这一渗漏,至今尚未测量.

blocks.en: A complementary line of work avoids leakage by construction, designing models whose output decomposes exactly into the contributions of their inputs. Such models pair each prediction with explicit concept relevances [ 3 ] , classify from local patches with a bounded receptive field [ 12 ] , express the logit as an exact sum of per-pixel [ 10 ] or per-patch [ 33 ] contributions, or encode learned groups of features separately before summing their scores [ 78 ] . They share our goal and differ mainly in the unit of explanation, from pixels and patches to feature groups selected per image, none of which refers to the same region across images. Our unit is a semantic part that does, encoded in isolation, with interactions confined to explained pair terms and compared against learned class prototypes. Aniraj et al . [ 5 ] also encode parts in separate streams, to remove leakage from attribute predictions, whereas we measure how much existing part-based classifiers depend on leakage and build a classifier whose decision is an exact sum over isolated parts and their pairs.

blocks.en: 3.2 Hierarchical part discovery

blocks.en: An isolated part cannot draw on context to compensate for an inconsistent segmentation, so its evidence is only comparable across images if the part covers the same region of the object in each of them. We discover parts on frozen self-supervised features within a foreground mask Ω \Omega obtained by co-segmentation as in [ 4 ] , cropping each image to the bounding box of its mask and using no part or box annotations. Parts form a two-level hierarchy of K K coarse parts, each divided into a fixed set of finer sub-parts. Every patch is assigned softly to the coarse parts and a background part by its distance to learned centres in a learned projection of its feature, and the share of each coarse part is divided among its own sub-parts only, so that sub-parts compete with their siblings and lie within their parent (equations in Sec. 7.1).

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We evaluate on 7 fine-grained benchmarks: CUB-200-2011 [ 73 ] , FGVC-Aircraft [ 47 ] , Stanford Cars [ 41 ] , Oxford Flowers-102 [ 51 ] , Oxford-IIIT Pets [ 53 ] , NABirds [ 70 ] , Stanford Dogs [ 35 ] , and 4 general-object benchmarks: STL-10 [ 18 ] , PASCAL VOC [ 21 ] object crops, PartImageNet [ 28 ] , and ImageNet-S50 [ 23 ] . Neither part nor box annotations are used for training or testing, and CUB keypoint annotations are used only to evaluate part quality.

blocks.en: We compare with five part- and prototype-based ViT classifiers [ 16 , 77 , 44 , 6 , 80 ] , with a classifier that encodes groups of features separately by design [ 78 ] and, for accuracy only, with a classifier whose logit decomposes exactly over pixels [ 11 ] since its explanations are not organised into parts. All competitors are trained with their official code and backbones, and we refer to [ 80 ] as Zhu et al . Each is also evaluated with its explained regions encoded in isolation as described in Sec. 3.1 , first with its trained weights unchanged and then, after retraining, its last blocks and head under isolation, keeping the better of its own training schema and ours on held-out data.

blocks.en: 4.2 Existing part-based ViTs depend on leakage
blocks.zh: 4.2 现有的基于部分的虚拟技术取决于渗漏

blocks.en: Table 1: Accuracy (%) with and without leakage. Leaky , the original method (for Ours, the same model with full attention); Isolated , the same weights with each explained region encoded only from its own patches; Retrained , the last blocks and head retrained under isolation. Ours is isolated by construction. Bold, best per column excluding Isolated . Other datasets in Sec. 8.1.
blocks.zh: 表1:有渗漏和没有渗漏的准确性(%)。 Leaky),最初的方法(对于Ours, 完全注意相同的模型); 孤立(Isolated), 相同的重量,每个被解释的区域只从自己的补丁编码; 重新训练 , 最后一个块和头在隔离下重新训练. 我们被建筑隔离了 粗体,每列最好,不包括隔离 其他数据集见Sec.8.1.

blocks.en: Table 2: Cross-part conflation and retained evidence (%, CUB, 200 test images, Eq. 1 ). Removed pixels are replaced by mean colour, blur or noise. IsoPartFormer (leaky) is our model with full attention.
blocks.zh: 表 2: 截面拼接和保留证据(%, CUB, 200 测试图像, Eq. 1 ) 。 删除的像素被平均颜色、 模糊或噪音所取代。 IsoPartFormer(leaky)是我们全心全意的模特儿.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Share of a part’s evidence that a model still credits to it after the part’s pixels are replaced by the mean colour (top, part; bottom, masked). Evidence that truly comes from the part should vanish when it is masked, so lower is better. Existing models keep 75–95%, which must come from the rest of the image, whereas ours keeps 3%, which isolation guarantees comes from the mean-colour region itself rather than from other parts.
blocks.zh: 图3:某一部分的证据表明,该部分的像素被平均颜色(顶部、部分、底部、遮罩)取代后,该模型仍可抵免。 真正来自这个部分的证据 当它被掩盖时应该消失, 所以更低是更好的。 现有模式保留了75-95%,这必须来自其他图像,而我们的模式保留了3%,而隔离保障则来自中色区域本身而不是其他部分。

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that every part- and prototype-based classifier loses most of its accuracy when its explained regions can no longer exchange information. On CUB, isolation reduces the accuracy of PDiscoFormer and Zhu et al . by 33 points, that of ProtoPNet and ProtoPFormer by 40 and 48 points, and that of ProtoViT almost to chance, with drops of the same order on Aircraft and Cars. Retraining recovers only part of this, and ProtoViT, ProtoPNet, and ProtoPFormer remain 24 to 69 points below their leaky accuracy. The exception is SOP [ 78 ] , which already encodes its feature groups separately and even improves when retrained. The collapse of ProtoViT is not an artefact of our protocol, since using our parts as its regions recovers 44.8% on CUB (Sec. 8.2). IsoPartFormer loses 0.7 to 3.2 points relative to the same model with full attention, which is the price of explanations that leak nothing, and remains more accurate than every retrained competitor and than every leaky competitor on CUB and Aircraft.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,每个基于部分和原型的分类器在被解释的区域不再能够交流信息时,其准确度会大为下降。 在CUB上,隔离使PDiscoFormer和Zhu等人的精度降低了33分,ProtoPNet和ProtoPFormer的精度降低了40分和48分,ProtoViT的精度几乎是偶然的,飞机和汽车的精度也下降了同样的订单. 再训练只恢复了其中的一部分,而ProtoViT,ProtoPNet和ProtoPFormer仍然低于其泄漏精度的24到69分. 例外是SOP [78],它已经单独编码其特征组,在重新训练时甚至会改进. ProtoViT的崩溃并不是我们协议的异物,因为使用我们作为区域的部分在CUB上恢复了44.8%(第8.2节)。 IsoPartFormer相对于完全注意的同一型号损失了0.7至3.2分,这是解释的代价,没有泄露任何信息,并且仍然比每一个重新训练的竞争对手以及CUB和Aircraft上的每一个泄露的竞争对手更准确.

blocks.en: Table 2 measures the same dependence in pixel space. For the part- and prototype-based competitors, 8 to 52% of the evidence credited to a part changes when the other parts are removed, and 62 to 108% remains after the part’s own pixels are removed ( Fig. 3 ), so their part evidence is largely carried by the rest of the image. Our model has zero conflation under every form of removal, while its leaky variant is as conflated as the competitors, so the effect is caused by attention rather than by the choice of parts, and it holds for blur and noise as well as a constant colour (Sec.  9.5; examples of every method and form of removal in Sec. 13).
blocks.zh: 表2测量了像素空间中相同的依赖性. 对于基于部分和原型的竞争者来说,8-52%的计入部分的证据在其他部分被移除时会发生变化,62%至108%在部分自己的像素被移除(图3)后仍然留存,因此其部分证据大多由其他图像携带. 我们的模型在每一种清除方式下都是零混杂的,而其渗漏的变体则和竞争者一样混杂,所以效果是由注意而不是选择零件引起的,它具有模糊和噪音以及恒定的颜色(Sec 9.5;第13章中每一种清除方式和形式的例子).

blocks.en: 4.3 Faithfulness and part quality
blocks.zh: 4.3 忠诚和部分质量

blocks.en: Table 3: Interpretability on CUB. Parts : consistency, stability and distinctiveness of parts following [ 80 , 31 ] (all test images). Part-level faithfulness (200 test images): rank correlation between each part’s claimed contribution and the actual effect of removing it, and the gain of deletion and insertion curves ordered by the claimed contributions over a random order (%). The feature groups of SOP are selected per image and have no identity across images, so part metrics do not apply.
blocks.zh: 表3:CUB的可解释性。 部分 : [80, 31] (所有试验图像)之后部分的一致性、稳定性和独特性。 部分层次的忠诚度(200个测试图像):将每个部分声称的缴款与去除缴款的实际效果之间的关联排序,以及按索赔缴款按随机顺序排列的删除和插入曲线的收益(%)。 SOP的特征组是每个图像选择的,没有跨图像的身份,因此部分度量法不适用.

blocks.en: Our terms sum exactly to the logit, but exactness alone would hold for any linear head, so we test whether a part’s claimed contribution predicts the effect of actually removing the part from the image. Table 3 shows that it does, with a rank correlation of 0.94 between claimed and actual effects, against at most 0.34 for the competitors, whose claimed contributions are only weakly related to the effect of removing the corresponding region. The deletion and insertion gains, which reward placing the most influential parts first, are also highest for our model, at 15.7 and 16.7 points against at most 12.0 and 10.4 for the competitors. Pixel-level deletion and insertion metrics for all methods and further details of the randomisation test are given in Secs. 9.2 and 9.3. The explanations also pass the model-randomisation test [ 2 ] , as re-initialising the class prototypes, and then also the fine-tuned blocks, reduces the rank correlation between the contrastive contributions of the trained and randomised models to zero on CUB and Aircraft and accuracy to near chance. A swap test confirms isolation directly, since a part replaced by the same part of an image of another class names the original class in at most 0.5% of cases on the fine-grained datasets and the donor class in 57 to 80%, while the term of every other part changes by at most 0.044 (Sec. 9.4), so an explanation can be edited one part at a time with a predictable effect, which the conflation of leaky classifiers rules out ( Tab. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的术语与记录完全一致,但对任何线性头来说,只有准确性才能维持,因此我们测试一部分声称的贡献是否预示着从图像中移除这部分的效果。 表3显示,在索赔与实际影响之间,其等级关系为0.94,对竞争者而言,其等级关系最多为0.34,而竞争者的索赔贡献仅与去除相应区域的影响密切相关。 将最有影响力的部分放在首位的删除和插入收益对我们的模式来说也是最高的,对竞争者来说,最高为15.7和16.7分,最高为12.0和10.4分。 所有方法的像素级删除和插入度量衡以及随机化测试的进一步细节见Secs.9.2和9.3. 解释还通过了模型随机化测试[2],作为类原型的重新初始化,然后是微调的块,将训练有素和随机化的模型的对比性贡献在CUB和Aircraft上降低到零,精确度接近概率. 互换测试可以直接确认隔离,因为另一类的图像的同一部分以57%至80%的精细数据集和捐赠者类别中最多0.5%的原类取而代之,而其他每个部分的用词则以0.044(Sec. 9.4)的最多变化,因此解释可以一次编辑一部分,具有可预测的效果,而漏泄分类器的拼接排除了(Tab. 2).

blocks.en: Our parts are also the most consistent and the most stable across images among the compared methods, with a consistency of 67.8 and a stability of 93.4 against 63.0 and 79.3 for the strongest competitor, respectively, which indicates that a part of our model refers to the same region of the object across images and under perturbation. The distinctiveness of our parts is close to that of the best method, which learns a dedicated set of discriminative parts [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们的部位也是比较方法中不同图像之间最一致和最稳定的部位,最强竞争者的一致性分别为67.8,稳定度分别为93.4,稳定度分别为63.0和79.3,这表明我们模型中的一部分是指物体跨图像和扰动下的同一区域. 我们各部分的独特性接近于最佳方法,它学习了一套专门的歧视性部分[6].

blocks.en: 4.4 Accuracy
blocks.zh: 4.4 准确性

blocks.en: Table 4: Test accuracy (%) on 11 benchmarks. Bold : best among isolated competitors and Ours; underlined : best among leaky competitors and Ours; italics : second best among isolated competitors and Ours. NAB: NABirds; VOC: PASCAL VOC object crops; PIN: PartImageNet; IN-S50: ImageNet-S50.
blocks.zh: 表4:11项基准的测试准确性(%)。 粗体:在孤立的竞争者和我们的竞争者中最好;强调:在泄密的竞争者和我们的竞争者中最好;斜体:在孤立的竞争者和我们的竞争者中最佳。 NAB:NABIRDS;VOC:PASCAL VOC物体作物; PIN:PartImageNet;IN-S50:图像网-S50.

blocks.en: Table 4 compares accuracy on all eleven benchmarks. Under the same isolation, our model is the most accurate method on every dataset except PASCAL, where the isolated variant of Zhu et al . remains ahead, and its margins over the best retrained competitor are largest on the most fine-grained benchmarks, at 4.0 points on CUB, 6.8 on Aircraft, and 5.2 on Cars. Against the original competitors, with their leakage, our model is the most accurate on CUB, Aircraft, Pets, NABirds, and Dogs, level with the best on PartImageNet and within 0.1 points of it on Flowers, and behind the best leaky method on Cars, STL-10, PASCAL, and ImageNet-S50. On the general-object benchmarks, part of this gap is explained by our model seeing only the object, whose background a leaky classifier can read, which may matter for classes such as ships and aircraft in STL-10. The ViT-B variant of our model is more accurate than every competitor of the same size on CUB and remains ahead of all isolated competitors on the fine-grained benchmarks except Flowers and Pets, so the advantage of our model does not derive from the larger backbone alone (competitors with a ViT-g backbone are compared in Sec. 8.3).
blocks.zh: 表4比较了所有11项基准的准确性。 在同样的隔离下,我们的模型是除PASCAL外每个数据集最准确的方法,其中左等的孤立变体仍然领先,它在最精细的分数基准上对最佳再训练竞争者的幅度最大,CUB4.0分,飞机6.8分,汽车5.2分. 我们的模型在CUB、Aircraft、Pets、NABirds和Dogs上是最准确的,在PartImageNet上和在其中0.1点之内在Flowers上达到最高水平,在汽车上达到最佳的泄露方法STL-10、PASCAL和ImageNet-S50之后达到最高水平。 在一般目标基准上,这一差距的一部分由我们的模型来解释,它只看到物体,其背景一个漏泄的分类器可以读取,这可能对STL-10中的船舶和飞机等类别很重要. 我们模型的Vit-B变体比CUB上每个大小相同的竞争对手更准确,在除花和宠物外的精致基准上仍然领先于所有孤立的竞争对手,因此我们模型的优势并不单从更大的骨干中产生(Vit-g骨干的竞争对手在8.3中比较).

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation
blocks.zh: 4.5 违约

blocks.en: Table 5: What each component adds (CUB, ViT-g). Each row adds one component to the row above, and bold marks the property it is responsible for. Part quality is NMI / ARI against annotated keypoints at the finest part level, and Ambiguous is accuracy on the 25% of test images on which a separately trained parts-only model is least certain between its two top classes.
blocks.zh: 表5:每个组成部分都添加了什么(CUB、Vit-g)。 每行在上行增加一个组件,并用粗体标出其所负责的财产. 部分质量是NMI / ARI 相对于最优部分的注解键点, Ambigacy是25%的测试图像的准确性, 其中单独训练的仅限零件模型在两个顶级之间最不确定.

blocks.en: Table 5 builds our model one component at a time, where isolation removes leakage and every later component addresses a cost of isolation. Isolating the parts of a frozen backbone removes all cross-part conflation and raises the faithfulness of the part contributions from 0.53 to 0.85, at a cost of only 0.7 points of accuracy. Refining the parts through their sub-parts leaves accuracy unchanged but brings the sub-parts considerably closer to the annotated anatomy of the birds, raising NMI by 8.6 and ARI by 19.5 points, and the comparison with flat discovery at the same number of parts (60.4 / 35.0) shows that the gain comes from the hierarchy rather than from the larger number of parts (Sec. 11.3). The pair edges then add 0.8 points overall and 2.9 points on the quarter of test images in which the appearance of individual parts is most ambiguous. Finally, isolated fine-tuning, which adapts the last blocks to parts and pairs that are each seen alone, adds a further 1.9 points while every term remains computed only from the patches it is credited to. The same fine-tuning applied with full attention would reach 92.6 ( Tab. 1 ), but only by teaching the part tokens to draw on the rest of the image, which raises cross-part conflation from 8.2 to 20.4 and lowers faithfulness to 0.31.
blocks.zh: 表5为我们的模式构建了一个组件,隔离可以消除渗漏,以后每个组件都解决隔离费用问题。 隔离冷冻骨干部分,可以消除所有交叉部分的拼接,将部分贡献的忠实度从0.53提高到0.85,成本精确度仅为0.7点. 通过子部位对部分进行精炼,其精度保持不变,但使子部位相当接近于鸟类的注释解剖学,使NMI上升了8.6分,ARI上升了19.5分,与相同数量的部分(60.4/35.0)的扁平发现的比较表明,收益来自等级,而不是更多部分(第11.3节). 配对边缘再整体上增加0.8分,在单个部分的外观最模糊的测试图像季度上增加2.9分. 最后,孤立的微调使最后一个区块适应每个区块单独看到的零件和配对,又增加了1.9分,而每个术语只从它的补丁中计算出来。 同样的经过充分注意的微调将达到92.6(表1),但只能通过教授部分符号来吸取图像的其余部分,这把跨部分的混音从8.2调到20.4调到0.31调到0.31调到.

blocks.en: 4.6 Qualitative results
blocks.zh: 4.6 定性结果

Middle, training image of the predicted class with a similar part layout. Right, contribution of each part and of the strongest pairs, with each part shown next to the closest same parts in training images of the class.

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows an explanation of IsoPartFormer for a test image from CUB (further examples in Sec. 13). Since parts are shared across images, each node can be shown together with the same part in training images of the predicted class, and because the contributions sum to the margin of the prediction, the explanation states precisely how much each part and each pair of parts contributed to choosing one class over its closest alternatives.
blocks.zh: 图4显示了IsoPartFormer对CUB测试图像的解释(第13节中的其他例子)。 由于各部分在图像之间共享,每个节点可以在预测班级的训练图像中与同一部分一起显示,并且由于对预测差值的贡献总和,解释中精确地说明了每个部分和每对部分在选择一个班级而不是其最接近的替代品方面的贡献.

blocks.en: 4.7 Preliminary human study
blocks.zh: 4.7 初步人类研究

blocks.en: Table 6: Pilot human study on CUB ( N = 33 N=33 ). True class picked among four candidates (all trials / trials the model got right), simulatability, and mean confidence for correct / incorrect answers.
blocks.zh: 表6:关于CUB的人类实验研究(N=33N=33). 真正的班级从四个候选人中挑选(所有审判/审判模型都是正确的),可互换性,意味着对正确/不正确答案的信心。

blocks.en: Fewer than 1% of explainable AI papers test their explanations with people [ 65 ] , so we conducted a pilot study with 33 participants following the task-based protocol of [ 37 ] , comparing our explanations with those of two part-based classifiers [ 44 , 6 ] and a saliency method [ 62 ] on CUB (Protocol in Sec. 12). Table 6 shows that, with our explanations, participants identified the true class most often, predicted the decision of the model most often, and that their confidence separated correct from incorrect answers most clearly, with a significant difference to PDiscoFormer ( p = 0.02 p=0.02 ). These results suggest that faithful explanations make the decisions of the model easier to anticipate. This research received approval by the Lancaster University FST Ethics Committee.
blocks.zh: 不到1%的可解释的AI论文用人检验其解释[65],因此我们进行了一项试点研究,33名参与者遵循了[37]的任务协议,将我们的解释与两个部分分类者的解释[44,6]和关于CUB(第12章中的议定书)的显著方法进行比较。 表6显示,根据我们的解释,与会者最经常地确定真正的类别,最经常地预测模型的决定,他们的信心与错误的答案最明确地区分正确,与PDiscoFormer(p=0.02 p=0.02)有很大区别. 这些结果表明,忠实的解释使模型的决定更容易预料。 这一研究获得了兰开斯特大学FST伦理委员会的认可.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced region faithfulness as a testable property of explanations that attribute a decision to image regions, and showed that part- and prototype-based ViTs violate it, losing most of their accuracy once their explained regions are encoded in isolation. IsoPartFormer achieves region faithfulness by construction while achieving the highest mean accuracy among tested interpretable classifiers across 11 benchmarks. Our method’s explanations predict the effect of removing a part far better than those of competing methods (rank correlation 0.94 vs. at most 0.34), its parts are the most consistent and stable across images, and participants anticipate its decisions most often. The isolation audit needs no part annotations, applies to any classifier that explains its decisions through regions, and exposed leakage in every part- and prototype-based ViT we tested. We recommend it as a standard audit for any such method, and IsoPartFormer shows that it can be passed without sacrificing accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了区域忠实作为解释的可验证属性,将决定归属于图像区域,并显示基于部分和原型的ViTs违反了它,一旦其解释区域被单独编码,其准确性将丧失大部分。 IsoPartFormer通过建筑实现区域忠诚,同时在经过测试的可解释分类器中达到最高平均准确度,达到11项基准。 我们的方法解释预言去除一部分的效果远胜于相互竞争的方法(排在0.94对最多0.34),其部分在图像中是最一致和稳定的,参与者最经常地预料到它的决定。 隔离审计不需要部分说明,适用于任何通过区域解释其决定的分类者,并暴露了我们测试的每个基于部分和原型的VIT的渗漏. 我们建议将它作为对任何此类方法的标准审计,IsoPartFormer显示,它可以在不牺牲准确性的情况下通过。
